Which statement shows that a liquid is pure water?
A
It boils at 100°C.
B
It has a pH value of 7.
C
It turns blue cobalt(II) chloride pink.
D
It turns white copper(II) sulfate blue.

options.label: B
options.text: It has a pH value of 7.

options.label: C
options.text: It turns blue cobalt(II) chloride pink.

options.label: D
options.text: It turns white copper(II) sulfate blue.
